items: Guest feedback shows you how people see your food, service and ambiance, and acting on it builds satisfaction, loyalty and a contact list for future offers.
Collect feedback through short surveys with clear goals, QR codes or links sent after the order, and friendly conversations with guests as they settle the bill.
Ask about specific areas, such as staff and service, menu, food quality and ambiance, to find the parts of the experience that need work.
Bring feedback from every channel into one place with analytics and sentiment analysis by store and item, so you can spot patterns and act on them.
Momos Surveys and sentiment analysis help you collect feedback through branded QR codes or links and break results down by store, item and category.
